    Your field companion.
    Capture a photo, mark the detail, and save or share a clear record.
    On your iPhone
    Open in Safari, then Share → Add to Home Screen. Allow camera and precise location when prompted.
    Originals & photo quality
    The shutter opens your phone camera. RASD keeps the supplied file unchanged, and exports edits as full-resolution PNG. iOS controls the file it supplies; this web app cannot guarantee Apple Camera HDR, ProRAW or 48 MP capture. Photos up to 25 MB and 80 MP are supported, subject to device memory.
    16:9 capture
    Choose 16:9 in the Apple Camera app, then import the photo here. The camera opened by Safari may offer fewer controls; RASD cannot set its native aspect ratio. New photos are never cropped automatically.
    Before heading to site
    Open RASD online once and wait for Offline ready. Try saving a photo, then reopen offline.
    Preparing offline mode…
    Your notes stay with you
    Photos and descriptions are not uploaded. Each device has its own library. Settings have no expiry set by RASD. Clearing website data or browser storage eviction can remove them and your notes. Use the Home Screen app and keep full backups in Files or iCloud Drive. Back up everything includes settings, categories and projects.
    Save & Next
    Save & Next saves the complete note and returns to the camera. Tap the shutter for the next photo. The next note keeps the project and category, starts with a blank description and requests fresh GPS. End round returns to your usual defaults. Cancelling the camera keeps the next-note context; reloading RASD ends it.
    Video notes
    Tap the shutter for a photo; hold it to record video with sound and release to stop. Allow camera and microphone access first. Record video with phone camera and Library are alternatives. Clips are limited to 1 minute and 50 MB; they are saved and shared unchanged, with your selected message text. Keep RASD visible while recording. Video is not annotated or stamped. PDF reports show a still preview; share the video file separately. Save your recording before leaving the app.
    Several photos, one note
    Use + below the photo to add from Camera or Library. Each photo keeps its own markup; the note, category and location are shared. Tap an item to move it or drag its handles. Tap selected text again to edit it on the photo.
    Quick phrases
    Choose a category, then Quick phrases to append an observation. Manage phrases in Settings. Full backups include your phrases and every photo.
    Drafts
    Edits save automatically on this device. Wait for Draft saved before leaving. Resume from Camera or Notes; Save note adds the finished note to your library. Save or discard drafts before making a full backup.
    PDF reports
    In Notes, tap Select, choose saved notes, then Create report. Preview every page before saving or sharing one PDF. All photos and markup are included. Reports use saved versions; save draft changes first if needed. Reports are created on this device and are not stored in your library.
    Sharing
    Choose WhatsApp in the share sheet. If the note is missing, copy it into the caption. WhatsApp can recompress photos; attach a downloaded file as a document for unchanged delivery.
